Commentary.Commentary: For Bangladesh, Rana was brilliant with the new ball but once the ball got old, the pacers struggled. Hasan though was extremely good. He bowled well in the middle overs but did not get a lot of support from the others. Their batters now face a massive task ahead. Still a lot of time in the game but they'll need a few special knocks. Sri Lanka on the other hand, will want to make most of the new ball. They'll hope to get a few before Stumps. Bangladesh on the other hand, will hope to enter Day 4 without losing any. Join us for the chase in a bit.

End of a fine, fine batting effort from Lanka and they have batted Bangladesh out of the game! Yet again the stars from the first innings did it for them. Both Dhananjaya and Kamindu scored tons and have taken them to a massive score. There were a few starts for the others as well but it was these two who were the highlight.

OUT! TAKEN! That is the end of the innings and that ends another wonderful knock from Mendis. Flatter and outside off. Mendis looks to drag it over mid-wicket but this goes off the top edge. It is taken by Hasan at mid-wicket.

Sri Lanka had a lead of around 100 runs before batting again but lost five wickets in the process. They’ll look to cross the 300-mark while Bangladesh will try and restrict them under 300. Anything under that will keep the game in balance. The first session could be the most crucial one of this game and whoever dominates might go on to win the game. Stay tuned.

Bangladesh whoever came out fighting with the ball. Rana bowled with fire and bagged early wickets for the hosts. Dimuth though showed good fight and he was well supported by Mathews and Dhananjaya de Silva who is off to a start. Lanka will hope they can somehow cross the 300 run mark and that will take some chasing. Bangladesh on the other hand, will hope they can take a few more wickets quickly and keep Lanka in tact. Do join us for the action on Day 3. Until then, goodbye and take care.

That wicket will make Bangladesh feel a lot better but they need a few of them quickly. Sri Lanka despite losing that wicket are ahead in the game. They lead by 111 right now and will hope they can string a couple of good partnerships. The hosts on the other hand, have started off well with the ball. The wicket is still offering assistance to the bowlers and Bangladesh will hope they cane maker use of it after the break. Stay tuned for what is an important session.
